clips.title: The story
paras: At the Shrine of Remulos, druids join the Pendant of the Sea Lion's two halves. The completed talisman marks an initiate's readiness to learn an aquatic form.

A druid must master the water's dangers to claim the sea lion's aquatic aspect. The pendant has two halves, one embodying the agility to slip past aquatic predators, the other the endurance to withstand prolonged submersion. At the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade, the pieces are joined into one.

After the pendant is forged, an initiate brings it to an elder mentor. Turak Runetotem waits on the rises of Thunder Bluff, while Mathrengyl Bearwalker is in Darnassus. The talisman proves the initiate has completed trials under Dendrite Starblaze, allowing the elder to teach the secrets of taking an aquatic form.
